messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — stitching deps for Acme private rollout. Need final owners for NAT/STUN, image sync, and airgap-ops. Cutover target: Thu 2026-04-14. Who's owning the firewall rule set? cc @Liam K, @NetEng

Liam K: I can do firewall rules but need the exact ports and CIDR list. Are we using ephemeral canary hosts or the shared LB? :thinking:

Maya R: Canary hosts. We'll use 10.240.0.0/18 for tenant subnets; canary range 10.240.10.0/24. Allow outbound 443 to artifacts.redwood-infra.net and 53 to customer DNS. Also permit SSH from jump IPs for image signing.

Anita S: Image signing: I'm blocked on HSM key access — Priya, did you get the KMS ticket approved?

Priya M: KMS ticket approved yesterday. I've sent HSM access to Anita (see runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/image-signing). Ops Bot will create temp creds for the canary.

Ops Bot: created temp creds for canary: expires in 48h — id: cb3f-... (DMed Anita). :white_check_mark:

NetEng: Firewall rules look fine. One ask: do we need outbound 123 (NTP) to public? If air-gapped customer, we should route NTP to internal stratum. Confirm.

Maya R: Good catch — for airgapped tenants, route NTP to bastion stratum (10.240.0.5). Update rule below:

```
iptables -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 123 -d 10.240.0.5 -j ACCEPT
ip6tables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -d artifacts.redwood-infra.net -j ACCEPT
```

Dave P: Can we run a preflight that verifies image pull + GPG signature + KV cache warm? I can own the preflight checklist and run it Wed morning.

Maya R: Please own it, Dave. Add a smoke that spins up canary + runs 200 prompt tokens through the model to validate latency SLO.

SRE Bot: Canary deployment job #138 queued -> started by Dave P (ETA ~30m). Logs: https://ci.redwood/infras/138

Liam K: Once firewall rules are applied, I'll run connectivity probe. I'll need the exact jump IPs for SSH (list pls).

Priya M: Jump IPs: 52.11.22.33, 52.11.22.34 (in runbook). I'll DM the key fingerprints.

Maya R: OK folks — owners: Firewall = Liam, Image signing = Anita, KMS = Priya, Preflight = Dave, NetEng = NetEng. If no blockers by EOD Wed we'll ship Thurs. :rocket:

NetEng: Acknowledged. I'll queue a NAT gateway change window Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Anita S: HSM access checked, signing key present. Will test signing in preflight.

Dave P: Preflight passed locally. Found one transient KV cache miss — logging a follow-up issue #412. Will attach logs.

Maya R: thanks — tagging follow-ups: @Liam K to apply rules, @NetEng to confirm NAT window, @Priya M to confirm KMS creds expiration aligned with canary. We'll reconvene async if any fails. :v:
